author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: The fallback URL builder uses a private word validator that duplicates the Reader selection validator.
findings.consequence: The copies can drift and make fallback, embed, and legacy lookup accept different selected-word sets.
findings.evidence: readerLookupWord and validatedReaderWord independently implement the same trim, length, whitespace, and control-character policy.
findings.recommendation: Reuse one Reader-word normalization policy at selection, embed URL, and fallback URL boundaries.
verification: Compared both validators and all three consumers.
Generated and read the exact current packet and adjacent policies.
Inspected the UI caller, dialog link, duplicate selection policy, complete unit tests, source wiring, and behavioral fallback coverage.
Used read-only inspection commands and made no repository edits.
